      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:
Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says remote.

REJECT if:
- Requires worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan

- Says worldwide remote, work from anywhere, global remote, APAC remote
- Allows international contractors
- Accepts people based anywhere
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement

  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",

}

Job post to evaluate:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}

Description: {{ $json.description.substring(0, 2000) }}"

setup_steps: 1. GOOGLE SHEETS: Create a Google Sheet named 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 sheets: 'Raw Jobs', 'Filtered Jobs', 'Applied', 'Rejected'. See column headers below.
2. GOOGLE SHEETS ID: Copy the Sheet ID from the URL (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SHEET_ID/edit) and replace all REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID values.
3. GOOGLE SHEETS CREDENTIAL: Add a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential in n8n and replace REPLACE_WITH_CREDENTIAL_ID.
4. OPENAI CREDENTIAL: Add an HTTP Bearer Auth credential with your OpenAI API key. Replace REPLACE_WITH_OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID.
5. GMAIL CREDENTIAL: Add a Gmail OAuth2 credential and replace REPLACE_WITH_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID.
6. ACTIVATE: Toggle the workflow active — it will run every day at 8:30 AM Asia/Taipei.

scoring.taiwan_eligibility: 40 pts (yes+low risk), 35 pts (yes), 30 pts (APAC), 20 pts (unclear), 0 pts (no)
scoring.role_fit: 25 pts (data analyst / AI marketing / BI / growth), 15 pts (adjacent roles)

_readme.one_sentence_rule: Every job must pass: I can do this job while living in Taiwan, without moving, without foreign work authorization, and without destroying my sleep schedule.
notes: Wellfound and YC may return HTML rather than JSON — consider adding Apify scrapers for those sources.
The AI Taiwan check uses gpt-4o-mini for cost efficiency. Swap to gpt-4o in the AI Taiwan Eligibility Check node for higher accuracy.
The SplitInBatches node (batch size 10) prevents OpenAI rate limit errors.
The Aggregate node collects all scored jobs before building the digest, so the email reflects the full day's results.
Cover letters are stored in the 'notes' column of Filtered Jobs and are only generated for score >= 85.
